While it fails the strict textual prior, it does not fail class identity (confirmed by expert).

The Router identified texture anomalies (soft spines) and blur. 
1. Texture: The 'softness' of the spines is subtle. Real crab spines are sharp. The AI generation often smooths these high-frequency details. Severity 1.5 is appropriate.
2. Blur/Edge Bleeding: The topology mask shows a clean separation (confidence > 1.0), suggesting the boundary is well-defined despite the visual blur. The blur appears more like optical depth-of-field or low-resolution compression than generative melting. 
3. New Findings: The perceptual auditor noted 'slight noise'. This is consistent with the grainy quality of the image. No catastrophic structural artifacts (extra limbs, fusion) were found by experts or visually confirmed beyond the minor spine softness.
